caption: The drawing features two bonnets displayed on a gray-green background. The larger bonnet, positioned on the upper left, is depicted in a light grayish-beige color with intricate white lace detailing along the edges and seams, including small dotted patterns on the main section, parallel stripes of decorative stitching, and a prominent lace floral motif at the back. Two white ribbon ties hang down from the bonnet, curling gently at their ends. Near the lower right of the larger bonnet is a single smaller bonnet rendered in similar colors and style, also adorned with lace and floral designs, and accompanied by a simple ribbon tie. The composition places the larger bonnet to dominate the upper left of the image, with the smaller one below and to the right, both set against the plain, muted background which is framed by a lighter beige border.
title: Baby's Cap
